instruction: Candid outdoor photograph, medium full shot. In a sunny park with green grass and trees, two friends stand together. On the left, the East Asian man in a red polo shirt (R3) stands facing forward, smiling. On the right, the Black woman in a black beanie and red t-shirt (R5) stands facing forward, smiling. They stand side-by-side on the grass under soft sunlight filtering through the trees.
